theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v3 = p2v1)) (h1 : (p2v5 ≤ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v0 = p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 = p2v3)) (h4 : (p2v4 = p2v0)) : (p2v4 ≤ p2v4) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v4

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v3 = p2v1)) (h1 : (p2v5 ≤ p2v2)) (h2 : (p2v0 = p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 = p2v3)) (h4 : (p2v4 = p2v0)) : (p2v4 ≤ p2v0) := by
